newsitem.title: USA: Worldcom invests $300 million in UUNET network.
newsitem.headline: Worldcom invests $300 million in UUNET network.

text.p: Worldcom Inc. said Wednesday it plans to spend about $300 million to expand the network of its Uunet Technologies Inc. subsidiary, the world's largest provider of Internet services.
The expansion and upgrade will more than quadruple Uunet's available capacity, Worldcom said.
The company said it will install new-generation, high-density equipment throughout the United States, Canada and Puerto Rico that will support both analogue and digital dial-up traffic.

Uunet, based in Fairfax, Va., has about 50,000 business customers worldwide. It is the official Internet access provider to the Microsoft Network and also supports GTE, EarthLink Networks, WebTV Networks Inc and several other providers.
Worldcom stock fell 37.5 cents to $26.625 on Nasdaq at midday.
